review.reviewer: Jepson Taylor (delegated: determination by Grok Bot from C.9.3 STEP sha 3a8181.. + drawings 01/02/04, per instruction 2026-10-13)
review.status: APPROVED (delegated). Lands = guard-hole rim (closed hole) + choil lobe (radiused, between the two edges). hook_back reclassified SHARP.

retention_lands.name: guard_hole_rim
retention_lands.finish: as-machined, unsharpened, full stock (local t ~3.6 mm)
retention_lands.why: only closed full-thickness feature in covered zone; > 6 mm from any sharpened boundary

seating_lands.name: choil_lobe
seating_lands.why: leading non-sharp land in the insertion direction; positive stop so the tip never bottoms

keepouts.name: grip+ring
keepouts.origin: ≥60 mm grip + 25.4 mm ring exposed for one-handed draw

hazards_note: All cutting edges (inner/concave, spine-side incl. hook back to the point) + tip zone are sharp, ~0 edge width. Spine is NOT a retention or bearing surface. Only explicitly non-cutting geometry may be a land.

bumper_lands.name: choil_lobe_bumper
bumper_lands.why: leading non-sharp land in the insertion direction; positive stop so the tip never bottoms

declared_sharp.name: hook_back_edge_sp
declared_sharp.why: outer convex back of the hook is the continuation of the sharpened spine edge (fine spine scallops end ~x140, drawing 04) running to the point; drawing 02 shows only an as-modelled tip-zone edge flat 0.5->1.45 mm (x 160-182) which the thickness probe misses. Rule 2026-10-13: every cutting edge is sharp with ~0 edge width -> SHARP, not a land.
